content: Dawud issɛizz x tudart n Cawul i twařa wiss tnayen
Iryazen n Zif usin-dd ɣar Cawul ɣar Jibɛa, nnan: “Ma war issnuffar Dawud ixef nnes x tewrirt n Ḥaxila arendad n tnezruft?”
Xenni ikkar Cawul uca ihwa ɣar řexřa n Zif, akides teřt-ařaf n yeryazen ittwafarzen zi Israil, ḥima ad yarzu x Dawud di řexřa n Zif.
Iwta Cawul iqiḍan nnes ɣar webrid x tewrirt n Ḥaxila tenni arendad n tnezruft. Dawud iqqim di řexřa, iẓra Cawul iḍfar i-t-i-dd ɣar řexřa.
Maɣar Dawud tuɣa issekk ixbarjiyyen u netta tuɣa issen aqa Cawul igga ad dd-yas.

Dawud ikkar u yusa-dd mani tuɣa iwta Cawul iqiḍan nnes. Dawud tuɣa ittwařa mani tuɣa izzeř Cawul ak-d ukumandar n řɛeskar nnes, Abnir, mmis n Nir. Cawul iṭṭeṣ di řmargeḥ n ikarruten u řgens tuɣa inneḍ as-dd s iqiḍan nsen.

Xenni iṭṭef Dawud deg wawař. Issiweř ak-d Aximalik, Aḥitti, u ak-d Abicay, mmis n Ṣiruya, umas n Yuwab, inna: “Man wen akidi i ɣa ihwan ɣar Cawul di řmargeḥ n řɛeskar?” Abicay inna: “Necc ad kidek hwiɣ.”
Yusa-dd Dawud ak-d Abicay di ǧiřet ɣar řgens, u xzar, Cawul tuɣa iṭṭeṣ di řmargeḥ n ikarruten u lansa nnes tejju zzat i uzeǧif nnes di temmurt. Innḍen as-dd Abnir d řgens.
Xenni inna Abicay i Dawud: “Ass-a iqqen SIDI řeɛdu nnec deg ufus nnec. Ejj ayi řexxu ad t ssnuqqbeɣ ak-d temmurt s ict n tecti n lansa. War tteḥdijiɣ ad tt ggeɣ ict n twařa nneɣnit.”
Dawud inna i Abicay: “War t ttareddeǧ ca, maɣar man wen izemmaren ad yarr afus nnes ɣar umedhun n SIDI uca ad iqqim d afurri?”
Xenni inna Dawud: “S tidett am iddar SIDI, SIDI ad t iwwet: niɣ ad dd-yas wass nnes i di i ɣa immet niɣ ad dd-ihwa ɣar umenɣi uca ad ittwaneɣ.
SIDI ad ayi iḥḍa aqa necc ad wteɣ s ufus inu amedhun n SIDI. Ttzawgeɣ cek, ksi lansa i iǧan zzat i uzeǧif nnes d tebriqt n waman uca ejj aneɣ ad nuyur!”

Iksi Dawud lansa d tebriqt n waman i tuɣa din iǧan zzat i uzeǧif n Cawul uca ffɣen nitni. Uřa d ijj war t iẓri, řa d ijj war t yuci u uřa d ijj war ifiq, maɣar marra ṭṭṣen, minzi SIDI tuɣa isseɣḍes i-ten deg ijj n yiḍeṣ yuǧeɣ.
Dawud iɛdu ɣar uɣezdis nneɣni uca ibedd ɣar řaggʷaj x tqiccat n wedrar. Tuɣa iǧa ttasiɛ d ameqqran jar asen.
Iřaɣa-dd Dawud i řgens u i Abnir, mmis n Nir, inna: “Ma war dd-tarrid ca, Abnir?” Xenni yarra-dd Abnir, inna: “Min teɛnid cek wenni d ittřaɣan x ujeǧid?”
Xenni inna Dawud i Abnir: “Ma cek war teǧid d aryaz? Man wen di Israil i iǧan am cek? Mayemmi xenni war teḥḍid x sidi nnec, ajeǧid? Aqa ijjen zi řgens yudef-dd ḥima ad yareddeǧ ajeǧid, sidi nnec.

Min teggid war iǧi ca mliḥ. S tidett am iddar SIDI, kenniw d tarwa n řmewt, minzi kenniw war tɛessem x sidi nwem, amedhun n SIDI! Xzar mani ǧant řexxu lansa n ujeǧid d tebriqt n waman tinni tuɣa zzat i uzeǧif nnes!”
Cawul iɛqeř tmijja n Dawud, inna: “Ma ta d tmijja nnec, a mmi Dawud?” Dawud inna: “Aqa-tt d tmijja inu, sidi inu, ajeǧid!”
Xenni inna: “Mayemmi iḍeffar sidi inu amsexxar nnes ammu? Minzi min ggiɣ u man t řɛib i yumsen ɣar ufus inu?

Xenni řexxu, ejj ad iseř sidi inu, ajeǧid, i wawařen n umsexxar nnes. Mařa SIDI issehweř i cek xafi, iři ad icemm Netta tawhibt n řɣiǧet, maca mařa d iwdan i iǧan, xenni ad ttwaneɛřen nitni zzat i wudem n SIDI, maɣar nitni uẓẓřen xafi ass-a ařami war zemmareɣ ad qqimeɣ qqneɣ ɛad i řwart n SIDI, u maɣar nitni qqaren: ‘Ruh, sexxar i irebbiten inneɣni!’
Xenni řexxu, ejj idammen inu war ttizzřen deg ict n temmurt iggʷejen x SIDI. Minzi ajeǧid n Israil iffeɣ, ḥima ad yarzu x ijj n uyenni n ucurdu waha, am mammec yemmaren tasekkurt deg idurar.”

Xas uca inna Cawul: “Necc xḍiɣ, ɛqeb-dd, a mmi Dawud, maɣar necc war d ac tteggeɣ ɛad řɣar, minzi tudart inu tuɣa ass-a tsekkwa ɣarek di tiṭṭawin nnec. Xzar, necc ggiɣ tubbuheřya u weddareɣ s waṭṭas.”
Dawud yarra-dd, inna: “Xzar, aqa da lansa n ujeǧid. Ejj ijj zeg imsexxaren nnec ad iẓwa, ad tt-i-dd yawi.
Ad ixeǧeṣ SIDI kuř ijj x tsegda nnes d ttiqqet nnes, minzi SIDI tuɣa isellem i cek ass-a deg ufus inu, maca war xseɣ ca ad ggeɣ afus inu deg umedhun n SIDI.
Xzar, am mammec tuɣa tudart nnec ass-a tiɣřa di tiṭṭawin inu, ammu i ɣa tiři tudart inu di tiṭṭawin n SIDI tiɣřa. Netta ad ayi ifekk zi marra řeḥṣaret.”
Cawul inna i Dawud: “Aqa cek tᵉttwabarked, mmi Dawud. Min ma i ɣa tegged, aqa ad tawḍed ɛawed.” Xenni yuyur Dawud abrid nnes u Cawul iɛqeb ɣar wemcan nnes mani tuɣa izeddeɣ.
